mutants.label: omit the empty-output guard
mutants.find:
if not output:
            raise RuntimeError(f"narrator command returned empty output: {command}")

mutants.label: validate raw stdout before stripping
mutants.find:
if not output:
            raise RuntimeError(f"narrator command returned empty output: {command}")
mutants.replace:
if not completed.stdout:
            raise RuntimeError(f"narrator command returned empty output: {command}")

mutants.label: [control] use equivalent empty-string predicate
mutants.why: With text=True and subprocess output as str, an empty stripped string is exactly the case len(output) == 0 detects; this preserves the guard behavior for empty and whitespace-only results.
mutants.find:
if not output:
            raise RuntimeError(f"narrator command returned empty output: {command}")
mutants.replace:
if len(output) == 0:
            raise RuntimeError(f"narrator command returned empty output: {command}")
